scientific_question: Does the bounded pre-2025 observed-life population of exact BTC DVOL futures contain enough ordinary public trade observations, independent contract episodes and active trading days to justify a separately governed Discovery MVE when contracts already alive at the lower observation boundary are handled by deterministic clipping rather than rejected as bad metadata?
relationship_to_prior_gate: New source-feasibility gate. V0.1 remains failed at its frozen 1.0 metadata-integrity gate. V0.2 changes only lower-bound contract-overlap semantics and does not open economic outcomes.

lifecycle_trade_acquisition.slice_rule: deterministic 24-hour UTC slices; count=1000 sorting=asc; recursively bisect exactly-1000 slices until each leaf is below 1000 or <=1 second, otherwise technical failure
lifecycle_trade_acquisition.ordinary_public_trade_rule: Exclude records carrying a non-null block_trade_id or combo_id from liquidity counts. No direction, price, index level, mark level or amount distribution is summarized.

threshold_rationale_frozen: Identical to V0.1. No density, field-coverage, quarter-coverage or metadata-integrity threshold is lowered.
stop_rule: If any source-viability gate fails, stop. Do not lower thresholds, delete candidates, choose denser subperiods, widen into 2025/2026, or open economic outcomes.
post_pass_rule: Even on LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_DATA_PASS, STOP. A separate pre-Discovery authority is required before any economic outcome is opened.
